about: Teluk Senja, twelve villas on a private bay (made up), at dusk: the hotel's own four photographs first, then only the moves between photos that can see each other; the lobby and the villa are joined by a designed cut, never an invented corridor.
made_with: The demo's pictures were made with GPT Image 2.5 and its moves with MiniMax H3 Max Turbo; with this skill's tools they are nano-banana-pro and kling-v3-pro.

entrance.prompt: Real architectural photograph of the entrance of a small villa resort on a generic, unnamed tropical island, no famous landmarks, at dusk about twenty-five minutes after sunset, taken straight on from about six and a half metres away at eye level. A long, plain, calm wall of rough weathered coral stone, dark grey-brown in the dusk, fills the picture from left edge to right edge on both sides of the door, with no windows, no openings and no ornament, so its surface is quiet. In the exact centre, one tall closed door of dark oiled ironwood with a simple dark bronze pull, set in a deep stone reveal; the door takes about one ninth of the picture's width and is tall and narrow, and a thin line of warm light shows under it. One low stone step leads up to it. A single plain woven lantern glows above the door. A deep thatched alang-alang grass roof overhang runs across the whole top of the picture, its underside dark, its dry grass edge detailed. A few slender coconut palm trunks rise beyond the wall at both far sides against a deep indigo sky, with the last warm band low on the horizon just visible at the far edges. In the foreground, about four metres from the camera and slightly soft, two low coral-stone garden walls planted with lush dark broad-leaf tropical plants (ferns, philodendron, ginger leaves, no flowers) run across the picture on both sides of a narrow sand-and-stone path, about a metre wide, that leads straight to the door; the top line of the planting crosses the picture at about 62 % of its height from the top, and is fairly even. Deep indigo dusk: the lantern and the line under the door are the only warm light; the wall above the plants is calm and even in tone. Editorial hospitality photography, mixed light balanced by eye, no HDR look. Full-frame camera, 28 mm lens, eye height 1.5 m, straight verticals; clean, noise-free, crisp detail. A real photograph: no people, no footprints, no text, no signs, no logos, no pool, no flowers.
entrance.note: the title splits around the door; the planting stays below the letters

lobby-first.prompt: A real architectural photograph of the arrival lobby of the same small villa resort as in the reference picture: the same coral stone, the same dark ironwood, the same thatch, the same dusk at the same moment, about twenty-five minutes after sunset, on a generic, unnamed tropical island, no famous landmarks. Now we are inside, a few metres past the door, looking straight ahead along the middle of the room at eye level, through to the sea. An open-air pavilion with no walls on its far side, under a high thatched alang-alang roof carried on dark timber rafters and four tall square dark timber posts, two left and two right, framing the view symmetrically. Floor of large honed pale grey stone slabs, a clear wide aisle straight down the middle. On the left, low rattan seats with pale linen cushions around a low dark timber table; on the right, a long low bench and a wall panel of carved grey stone with a screen of woven pandan. Several plain woven lanterns hanging from the rafters and two standing on the floor, all lit warm, the same woven lantern as above the door. Beyond the open far side, past a low stone edge and a few palm trunks at the sides, the calm dark sea under a deep indigo sky with the last warm band on a clean flat horizon. Warm lantern light inside, soft and low in contrast, deep blue dusk outside, balanced by eye. Editorial hospitality photography, no HDR look. Full-frame camera, 24 mm lens, eye height 1.5 m, straight verticals; clean, noise-free, crisp detail. A real photograph: no people, no text, no signs, no logos, no flowers, no pool, no moon, no sun.

move-1.prompt:
The camera stands still for a moment while the tall dark wooden door in the centre swings slowly open inward on its hinges, away from the camera, showing warm lantern light beyond. The camera then walks slowly forward at eye level, straight along the stone path between the low walls and the plants, up the low step, through the open doorway, and on into the open-air pavilion under the thatched roof, ending looking down the middle of the pavilion at the calm sea at dusk. One smooth continuous forward walk, calm pace, no shake, no turn. Nothing else changes: walls, thatch, plants, lanterns, posts, furniture and the dusk sky stay solid and unchanged. No people.
 The sky is a still, cloudless dusk gradient: it never moves or changes, and no clouds appear.
